items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Do you know Destun's band? Yeah, Sidney. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, Destun, he's from Omaha, isn't he?

ctx.x: But I do know they were some kind of cousins or something.
